moodys.citation_text: Bond Buyer July 2024: 'Erlanger Health of Chattanooga, Tennessee, was upgraded by Moody's Ratings to Baa1 from Baa2' — implying Baa2 was the prior rating in effect through 2022-12-31 and into mid-2024. No surfaced interim Moody's action.

sp.citation_text: Erlanger's own IR blog confirms that S&P also upgraded in August 2024. Implied prior S&P rating was BBB+ based on parallel agency progression with Fitch BBB+ pre-upgrade. PARTIALLY VERIFIED: exact prior S&P notch and outlook not stated.

fitch.citation_text: Bond Buyer: 'Fitch Ratings to A-minus from BBB-plus' implies prior rating was BBB+ in effect on 2022-12-31.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Upgraded to Baa1 from Baa2; positive outlook
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Strengthened operating performance, growth in unrestricted cash and investments; consistent financial performance since FY2020; dominant market share (2x nearest competitor); EBITDA margin 7.7% over last four fiscal years; 7% operating cash flow margins.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Bond Buyer July 22, 2024: 'Erlanger Health of Chattanooga, Tennessee, was upgraded by Moody's Ratings to Baa1 from Baa2 and by Fitch Ratings to A-minus from BBB-plus. Both ratings agencies have positive outlooks on their rating.'

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Upgraded to A- from BBB+; positive outlook
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Same drivers as Moody's upgrade — improved liquidity ($480M cash vs $445M prior year), 115% cash-to-pro-forma-debt ratio, 140 DCOH at FYE 2024, $322M new bond issuance via Chattanooga Health, Educational and Housing Facility Board.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Bond Buyer July 22, 2024: Fitch upgraded to A-minus from BBB-plus with positive outlook.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Upgraded by S&P Global (specific notches not extracted)
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Parallel action to Moody's and Fitch upgrades.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Erlanger Health IR blog Aug 2, 2024: 'Erlanger Receives Credit Rating Upgrades from Standard & Poor's Global, Fitch, and Moody's'.

moodys.citation_text: Baa1/Positive per July 2024 upgrade; no surfaced subsequent action before 2025-03-31.

sp.citation_text: S&P upgraded to A- (inferred parallel notch to Fitch A-) per IR coverage; outlook positive.

fitch.citation_text: A-/Positive per July 2024 upgrade; no subsequent action surfaced before window end.

outcome_class_rationale: All three agencies upgraded one notch in July-August 2024 (Moody's Baa2->Baa1, Fitch BBB+->A-, S&P likely BBB+->A-). All assigned positive outlook. This is a textbook UPGRADE outcome. The $322M new debt issuance accompanied the upgrades.
